subject: Are you sure?
body:
You killed Conquest?? CONQUEST?? Kirkman wrote that guy so Mark could get the worst beating of his whole life. Viltrum sends him when a planet has said no one too many times, and he smiles the entire fight like Mickey house beating up some Disney adults. Y'know maybe him and I aren't so different.

He dropped three tubes of blood. We both know where those are going and it isnt a museum. So before you load up the Assembler I have to ask you one question.

Are you sure? The whole modpack might be too easy after you do that

-Questpool
